notes.title: Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny - Available Now!
notes.content: [p]Based on the novel [i]Sawarga Malapetaka[/i] and stories from Risa Saraswati’s [i]Jurnal Risa[/i], [b]Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny[/b] is now available on [b]Steam[/b]. This horror adventure visual novel brings Indonesian supernatural folklore into an interactive format for the first time.[/p][h3]Game Overview[/h3][p]Step into a story where daily life collides with the unseen. Play as members of the [i]Jurnal Risa[/i] team, uncover mysteries, encounter spirits, and make choices that shape how events unfold.[/p][h3]Key Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Paranormal Encounters[/b] – Confront spirits and reveal their presence through dialogue and choices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Choices & Endings[/b] – Certain decisions push the story forward, while others end it early with fatal consequences.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exploration & Mini-Games[/b] – Investigate haunted places, solve puzzles, and collect photo fragments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fully Voiced Cast[/b] – Featuring voices from the [i]Jurnal Risa[/i] team for added authenticity.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Atmospheric Design[/b] – Visuals, sound, and music work together to create a tense horror experience rooted in folklore.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for supporting [i]Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny[/i]. We hope you enjoy exploring this story of family, folklore, and the supernatural.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sMtXXMCo-fg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417470/Jurnal_Risa_Dark_Destiny/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[h1][b]Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny is Coming to You This September!
[/b][/h1][previewyoutube="yRspOjir6aA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hey everyone! We’re excited to finally share that [i]Jurnal Risa: Dark Destiny[/i][b] will be releasing on September 25, 2025 (GMT+7)[/b]![/p][p]It’s been a long journey getting the game ready, and we can’t wait for you to experience it for yourself. Thank you so much for sticking with us and supporting the project—it really means the world to the team.[/p][p]Make sure to [b]wishlist and follow[/b] the game here on Steam so you’ll get notified when it goes live. [/p][p][/p][p]We hope you're ready to face [i]the destiny[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]With love,

Digital Happiness :DH

[/p]

notes.title: DHXP 2025 Anniversary event
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for sticking with us all these years![/h1]

It's been over a decade since we began this journey, as this month marks [i]eleven[/i] years of Digital Happiness' first-ever launched title, DreadOut. What started as a small spark has grown into a world of stories and shared memories with you, our beloved players.

Everything we've built was made with passion, sleepless nights, and LOTS of coffee. And through it all, you've been there playing, supporting, and believing in us.

DHXP is the pulse of everything we’ve created so far. And to this day, it has always been more than a celebration, it’s a thank you, a look back, and a vision of what lies ahead.

And for you, thank you for being part of this journey. Whether you’ve been here since the beginning, or you just stumbled into our world someway somehow, we're glad you're here.

[h2]Then what lies beyond the 11th year?[/h2]

This is the fun part. Currently, there are so many things going on in our headquarters, and we're so excited to share them with you. We're working on titles that you might have expected and not expected!

[previewyoutube=uYlkB3py6EE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Also check out the DHXP 2025 Steam Sale Page by clicking the banner below:[/h3]

[url=bit.ly/dhxp2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33371531/f6f256432d7ba3a4c98fa44749cb058a7bd9463e.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Did someone mention sale?[/h2]
Of course, we have a special sale going on too! Take a look around and dive into the games that have shaped us as a developers. You can get it with [b]up to 80% off[/b]!

Please spread the news because this offer lasts through May 24, 2025!

Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH
